items.title: Solana Treasury DeFi Development Corp Eyes $20 Million Raise to Buy More SOL
items.whyYouShouldCare: A $20 million raise by Solana Treasury DeFi Development Corp could significantly increase SOL holdings, enhancing liquidity and market confidence.

items.title: DFDV uses CHAD stock to buy more SOL: A new catalyst for Solana’s $150 target?
items.whyYouShouldCare: DFDV's strategy to use CHAD stock for acquiring more SOL could create upward pressure on SOL's price, potentially influencing market sentiment towards a $150 target.

items.title: Why Robinhood Chain’s $1M revenue milestone signals a new on-chain battle
items.whyYouShouldCare: Robinhood Chain's $1 million revenue milestone indicates growing on-chain activity, which may drive increased usage and demand for the Solana ecosystem.
